ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Scan Loop Network
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of other systems by IP address, hostname, or other logical identifier on a network that may be used for Lateral Movement from the current system

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*for\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*foreach\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*nslookup.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ping.*")))
